title: FFLogs Playground
subtitle: Manually send GraphQL requests to FF Logs and inspect the raw response.

request.title: Request
request.description: Paste a raw GraphQL query, or a JSON payload with query, variables, and operationName.
request.placeholder: Paste a GraphQL query or JSON payload...

response.title: Response
response.description: The playground shows the raw backend result, including failed FF Logs responses.
response.empty: Run a request to see the FF Logs response here.

validation.json_object: JSON requests must be an object containing a query field.
validation.query_required: JSON requests must include a non-empty query field.
validation.variables_invalid: The variables field must be a JSON object or null.
validation.operation_name_invalid: The operationName field must be a string or null.

errors.request_failed: The FF Logs request could not be completed.
